$Comment: MMO Skill Tree's half of the Hallowed set: with a Jack Helm worn and a Jack Shield in the utility
slot, the wearer gets a little luck and more Artillery damage, on top of the health, glow and fire
resistance Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json gives. Members holds both helms (the Jack Helm and the
Burning Jack Helm) and both shields (the Jack Shield and the Flaming Jack Shield), the same four as
that set, so any helm with any shield completes it.
It is a second set over the same members, so that file stays as it is: an item can belong to
several sets, and each set's tiers apply on their own. Each set also shows its own notice when
its tier comes on, which is why a player sees two. Requires takes this file out on a server
without MMO Skill Tree, where these stats do not exist and its notice would name a bonus nobody
gets; always write it with Min 1.
MMO_Luck takes whole percent points (5 is 5%), the luck every skill's lucky rolls read.
MMO_DamageFlat_ARTILLERY adds raw damage to a hit while an Artillery weapon is in hand when it
lands, which for a Lantern Bomb means another bomb still in hand. Both are Additive on purpose:
these channels have a base of zero, so a Multiplicative entry computes nothing.
